tracks.title: Warm-up

lessons.title: Offbeat hats
lessons.goal: Put an open hi-hat on every offbeat.
lessons.concept: The **offbeat** is halfway between two beats. `"[~ oh]*4"` plays a rest then an open hat, four times a bar.

tasks.text: Add a part called hats that plays oh on every offbeat, and stack it.
tasks.hint: const hats = s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909"), then stack(kick, hats)

tasks.text: Turn the hats down to about .6.

challenge.text: Add closed hats (hh) on the beats, quieter than the open ones.
challenge.hint: const ticks = s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3), and stack it too

summary: Offbeats sit halfway between the beats.
.gain(…) sets how loud a part is.
